description: This file defines the StandardNormal class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing functions related to the standard normal distribution such as cumulative distribution, inverse, and statistical tests.

classes.name: StandardNormal
classes.description: Provides methods for calculations involving the standard normal distribution, such as cumulative probability, inverse, and z-test functions.

methods.name: cumulative
methods.description: Returns the standard normal cumulative distribution function for a given value.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Returns either the cumulative distribution function or the probability density function for the standard normal distribution.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Returns the inverse of the standard normal cumulative distribution for a given probability.

methods.name: gauss
methods.description: Calculates the probability that a standard normal variable falls between the mean and z standard deviations from the mean.

methods.name: zTest
methods.description: Performs a one-tailed z-test and returns the P-value for a given dataset and hypothesized mean, possibly using a specified sigma.
